# Adoption Attestation

An accepted adoption receipt identifies the active run, scoped target, candidate identifiers, exact provider and module
locks, authorized operation outcome, reconciliation evidence, observation time, and unresolved differences. Evaluate
the receipt against the declared criteria: each approved candidate is accounted for, no unapproved target is included,
and remaining differences are classified rather than silently accepted.

Carry accepted evidence identifiers and unresolved drift into the next kernel-selected task. A successful adoption
outcome is not a policy, security, cost, or deployment approval. Stale, partial, mismatched, or absent attestation is a
blocker and must be routed to the owning authorized capability.
